item.fw_spacesuit.space_suit.desc: Full suit: breathe in space. Holds 30 minutes of oxygen.
block.fw_spacesuit.oxygen_generator.desc: Uses 40 FE/t. Makes air within 8 blocks and refills space suits (right-click while wearing one).
msg.fw_spacesuit.no_air: No air! Wear a full space suit or stand near an oxygen generator.
msg.fw_spacesuit.empty: The generator has no oxygen stored
